newsitem.title: USA: Singing Machine files for Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Singing Machine files for Chapter 11.

text.p: The Singing Machine Co Inc said Friday it filed for protection from its creditors under the provisions of Chapter 11.
This filing, the company said, is the result of unresolved negotiations to schedule payments with several key creditors.
The company said it will operate under the protection of the filing and does not anticipate interruption of deliveries to any of its customers.

Company Chief Executive Eddie Steele issued a statement saying "now we can concentrate on building upon the sales success of last year, and continue to improve our market share in the mass market karaoke field, while improving profitability."
"Chapter 11 will give us the opportunity to put into place a comprehensive restructuring plan, while maintaining uninterrupted deliveries to our key mass merchant customers," the statement said.
